Players Committee card image of [[Palpatine, Emperor Returned (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2 image; errata mark “E1”), printing: “Never deploys or moves (even if carried) except to an [Episode VII] location without a [Light Side] icon. Once per turn, may draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, if about to be lost, may take him into hand. Immune to attrition.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/palpatineemperorreturned.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/palpatineemperorreturned.png] as of commit e9980f9 “Set 20 Errata, 2020 AIs, and a few fixes” (11 December 2022).
